newsitem.title: USA: Dow steady at higher levels after brief retreat.
newsitem.headline: Dow steady at higher levels after brief retreat.

text.p: U.S. blue chips returned to moderately higher levels in late afternoon, shrugging off a brief bout of selling pressure.
The Dow industrials stood at 7528, up 50 points for the session. Tech stocks remained weak, however, and the Nasdaq composite was off 12 points at 1400.

Analysts said international investment flows appeared to be boosting the Dow during the most recent leg of its rally, as investors abroad seek ways to sidestep mounting uncertainty over European Monetary Union.

"I think this bull has gotten a little extra life thanks to the questions about EMU," said Jack Shaughnessy, director of research at Advest. "People are starting to de-emphasize Europe (in their portfolios) and that money has to go somewhere."
Bonds remained slightly lower, with the benchmark 30-year U.S. Treasury off 5/32 to yield 6.84 percent. NYSE index-arbitrage program trading curbs remain in effect.
